display.purpose: Page titles and primary metric values.

title.purpose: Product identity and compact section anchors.

body.purpose: Interface copy, table content, descriptions, and controls.

motion.name: duration-standard

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The strongest page-level action, used once within a local decision group.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 36px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0 10px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Filters and secondary actions that stay visible without competing with the primary decision.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0 10px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact operational field with a visible boundary and an explicit indigo focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 4px 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 22%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The single current destination in the persistent cool sidebar.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0 12px; background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-accent), var(--sidebar-accent-foreground) 5%); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: A flat white evidence container with a restrained boundary and compact header hierarchy.
components.html:
Feedback movement

Received and resolved feedback across the selected period.

Evidence belongs here.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-card-header h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-manrope), sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card-header p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px 24px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; } .ds-card:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: At-Risk Status Chip
components.description: A semantic chip for critical or at-risk operational states.
components.html: At risk
components.css: .ds-chip-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.8); padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--dashboard-danger-soft); color: var(--dashboard-danger); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-danger svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-chip-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--dashboard-danger-soft), var(--dashboard-danger) 8%); } .ds-chip-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--dashboard-danger) 25%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Decision Brief
components.description: The single high-contrast intervention statement that turns evidence into a next action.
components.html:
The backlog is stable, but ownership needs attention.

Four critical items remain open; two have no owner. Client Portal is the first project to review.
components.css: .ds-decision-brief { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: stretch; overflow: hidden; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-decision-brief > div { padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-decision-brief h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-manrope), sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-decision-brief p { max-width: 720px; margin: 4px 0 0; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 70%, transparent); font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-decision-brief button { margin: 0; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 15%, transparent); padding: 0 24px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-decision-brief button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 10%, transparent); } .ds-decision-brief button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 70%, transparent); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-decision-brief button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-decision-brief { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-decision-brief button { min-height: 64px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 15%, transparent); border-left: 0; } }

components.name: Metric Summary Band
components.description: Connected operational metrics that compare as one evidence band instead of four detached cards.
components.css: .ds-metric-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-metric-band article { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-metric-band article + article { border-left: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-metric-band span { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-metric-band strong { font-family: var(--font-manrope), sans-serif; font-size: 30px; line-height: 36px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-band small { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; } .ds-metric-band b { color: var(--dashboard-primary); font-weight: 600; } .ds-metric-band article:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 45%, transparent); } .ds-metric-band article:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: -3px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-metric-band { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-metric-band article + article { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
InsightFlow should feel like a calm operational briefing prepared for someone who must decide where to intervene. Warm paper-like space and cool blue-gray structure keep the environment credible and quiet; a concentrated indigo voice marks selection and action, while semantic colors make risk and progress immediately legible.

The interface is intentionally not a uniform dashboard mosaic. It moves through a decision story: organization state, the intervention that deserves attention, evidence and trends, then project-level health. Density is operational but measured, with clean lines, concise copy, tabular numbers, and responsive transformations that preserve scanability.
keyCharacteristics: A decision sequence instead of a grid of equal-weight cards.
Warm white canvas, crisp evidence surfaces, and cool structural neutrals.
Indigo and violet accents used selectively for action, focus, and current state.
Green, amber, red, blue, and cyan signals paired with text or icons.
Manrope headings and Inter interface copy with restrained tracking.
Flat tonal layering, fine boundaries, and no decorative shadows at rest.
Persistent desktop sidebar; compact mobile header and bottom navigation.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo identifies selection, focus, action, or meaningful change; it is never a decorative fill pattern.

rules.name: The Evidence Has a Color Rule
rules.body: Semantic hues always travel with text, an icon, a label, or position so meaning never depends on color alone.

rules.name: The Two-Level Voice Rule
rules.body: Manrope names decisions and key evidence; Inter explains, labels, and lets people operate.

rules.name: The Decision-First Rule
rules.body: Order every dashboard from overall state to priority intervention, supporting evidence, and finally the health of individual projects.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: A resting card earns hierarchy through placement, tone, and boundary—not a floating shadow.

rules.name: The Contained Curve Rule
rules.body: Round the component enough to group it, never enough to make operational surfaces feel playful or pill-heavy.

rules.name: The One Intervention Rule
rules.body: The darkest surface on the page is reserved for the single operational conclusion that should change what the user does next.

dos: Do preserve the state → intervention → evidence → project-health reading order.
Do use semantic CSS tokens for every product color and keep component code free of hardcoded palette values.
Do pair color with labels, icons, numbers, or placement for every status and trend.
Do use tabular numerals and aligned columns wherever people compare operational values.
Do transform dense tables into readable cards or focused rows on mobile.
Do reserve the Decision Brief for one evidence-backed conclusion and one next action.
donts: Don't turn the dashboard into a uniform mosaic of equal cards.
Don't use shadows to decorate resting dashboard surfaces or manufacture hierarchy.
Don't spread indigo across large areas when neutral structure can carry the layout.
Don't use red, amber, green, blue, or cyan as decoration detached from operational meaning.
Don't squeeze desktop tables, sidebars, or multi-column controls into the mobile viewport.
Don't introduce highly pill-shaped controls, oversized radii, gradients, or ornamental effects that weaken the calm briefing character.
